scripts.config:build: luban -t all --conf .\configs\luban.conf -d json -d lua -x  tableImporter.name=wukong   -x lua.outputDataDir=_genConfigs -x json.outputDataDir=configs/jsonConfigs
scripts.docs:build: npm run predoc && vitepress build docs
scripts.docs:preview: npm run predoc && vitepress preview docs
scripts.release:doc: npm run zip && npm run docs:build && c2l_release.bat
scripts.prepack: npm run c2l:prepare &&  dotnet build wdm.WuKong.sln  && npm run c2l:build
scripts.predoc: node scripts/update_wukong_doc_config.js && luban -t all  -c  cs-mark-down --conf .\configs\luban.conf -x outputCodeDir=docs\apis -x codeStyle=lua-default --customTemplateDir luban_templates && node .\scripts\parse_markdown_structures.js && dotnet build WuKongCliTools && WuKongCliTools\bin\Debug\net8.0\WuKongCliTools.exe -p docs\.vitepress\cache\plugins.json && node .\scripts\append_doc_plugin_info.js
